name: MT-Bench
intro: MT-Bench是一个用于评估大型语言模型（LLM）多轮对话能力的基准。它通过一系列具有挑战性的开放式问题，测试模型在对话和指令遵循方面的表现。
org: UC Berkeley, Carnegie Mellon University, Stanford University, MBZUAI, UC San Diego, LMSYS
task_type: 对话, 开放式问答, 指令遵循
intro_en: MT-Bench is a benchmark for evaluating the multi-turn dialogue capabilities of large language models (LLMs). It tests models' performance in conversation and instruction following through a series of challenging open-ended questions.
mermaid_flowchart:
flowchart TD
    A[定义基准目标] --> B[确定问题类别]
    B --> C(8个常见用户提示类别)
    C --> D[为每个类别手动设计问题]
    D --> E(80个高质量多轮问题)
    E --> F[人类Evaluation员招募]
    F --> G{人类Evaluation员同意协议}
    G -- 同意 --> H[人类Evaluation]
    H --> I(MT-Bench问题和匿名助手回答)
    I --> J{人类Evaluation员投票}
    J -- 投票 --> K[收集人类偏好数据]
    K --> L{人类投票与GPT-4判断不一致?}
    L -- 是 --> M[展示GPT-4判断并请求合理性Evaluation]
    L -- 否 --> K
    K --> N[Quality Control: 允许跳过不确定问题]
    N --> O(3KExperts投票)
    O --> P(30K人类偏好对话)
    P --> Q[LLM作为评判者Evaluation方法]
    Q --> R{选择Evaluation类型}
    R -- 配对比较 --> S[LLM评判者比较两个助手回答]
    R -- 单一回答评分 --> T[LLM评判者给单个回答评分]
    R -- 参考指导评分 --> U[LLM评判者对比参考答案Evaluation]
    S --> V[ValidationLLM评判者与人类偏好一致性]
    T --> V
    U --> V
    V --> W[MT-BenchFinal Dataset]
metric_en: Using strong LLMs (such as GPT-4) as judges for scoring, and comparing with human preferences
flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["Identify 8 common user prompt categories for chatbot evaluation coverage"] --> B["Manually design 10 multi-turn questions per category, totaling 80 questions"]
    B["Manually design 10 multi-turn questions per category, totaling 80 questions"] --> C["Collect model responses to all multi-turn questions from candidate chatbots"]
    C["Collect model responses to all multi-turn questions from candidate chatbots"] --> D["Apply LLM judge using pairwise comparison or single answer grading prompts"]
    D["Apply LLM judge using pairwise comparison or single answer grading prompts"] --> E["Mitigate position bias by swapping answer order and aggregating judgments"]
    E["Mitigate position bias by swapping answer order and aggregating judgments"] --> F["Collect expert human votes on subset to validate LLM judge agreement"]
    F["Collect expert human votes on subset to validate LLM judge agreement"] --> G["Calculate agreement rate between LLM judges and human preferences"]

    B["每类手动设计10个多轮问题，共80个问题"] --> C["收集候选聊天机器人对所有多轮问题的回答"]

    E["通过交换答案顺序并聚合判断来缓解位置偏差"] --> F["收集专家人类投票验证LLM评判一致性"]
